headline: Frontier language models rank small-molecule conformers above UFF but below MMFF94
summary: Semakin et al. test whether language models can rank molecular conformers from 3D coordinates using relative-energy labels. Their benchmark covers 810 geometries from 27 small molecules. Table 1 reports GPT-6 Astra at mean reliable-pair Kendall τ 0.67 and Claude Opus 5 at 0.61, above UFF (0.23) but below MMFF94 (0.93) and GFN-FF (0.72). The result is a bounded author-run preprint benchmark, not evidence that language models replace molecular mechanics or generalize across chemical space.
